preconditions.description: There are exactly 5 rows of input.
Each registration code is at most 11 characters long.

preconditions.expression: all(code.isalnum() or '-' in code for code in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: Each registration code consists of uppercase letters, digits, or dashes.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'HE GOT AWAY!' if not any('FBI' in code for code in stdin.splitlines()) else True
postconditions.description: If no CIA blimps are found, output 'HE GOT AWAY!'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ' '.join(str(i+1) for i, code in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()) if 'FBI' in code)
postconditions.description: Output the indices of CIA blimps in increasing order.
